name: subnav
description: A vertical navigation for a sidebar, whose sections open in place: a parent page is its link with a toggle beside it, and its pages open below both.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the current page, its parents' rows, and the hover fill.

children.description: The links, one per li, with role="list".
One entry: a link, a link followed by a details holding its pages, or a details alone for a parent that is not a page. Each li holds at most one link and at most one details, as its own children.
A page. The current one carries aria-current="page".
A parent's pages, after its link or alone in its li. The template writes open on each details above the current page.

The toggle, first in each details. Beside a link it is empty and named by aria-label; without a link it holds the section's name. After it, each details holds one ul with role="list", one indent further in, which may nest the same shape again.

tokens.name: --yeti-subnav-indent
tokens.description: How far each level steps in.

tokens.name: --yeti-subnav-hover
tokens.description: The fill under the pointer; transparent turns it off.

tokens.name: --yeti-subnav-current
tokens.description: The current page, and the rows of the parents that hold it.

tokens.name: --yeti-control-size
tokens.description: A row's least height, and the toggle's square.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text
tokens.description: A link that is not current.

tokens.name: --yeti-weight-strong
tokens.description: Weight of the current page's link.

tokens.name: --yeti-duration-base
tokens.description: How long a section takes to open or close.

keyboard.action: Moves through the links and toggles in order; the pages of a closed section are skipped.
Opens or closes the section under the focused toggle.

a11y.notes: Give the nav an aria-label such as "Docs", since a page with a sidebar has at least two navs. Put role="list" on every ul, because the reset only removes list markers where that role says the list is decorative. The current page's link carries aria-current="page". A toggle beside a link has no text, so its summary carries an aria-label naming the section's pages, such as "Layouts pages". The summary is the browser's own disclosure button: it takes the keyboard and announces whether its section is open. Never put the link inside the summary, because a link inside a button is lost to screen readers.

unguarded: animating a grid row between 0fr and 1fr
